LanguageData.ASE_DoubleReactorCapacityHediff.label: double reactor capacity
LanguageData.ASE_DoubleReactorCapacityHediff.descript: Engineers increased the reactor capacity, but this slightly affects movement speed.
LanguageData.ASE_EMPGeneratorHediff.label: EMP reactor
LanguageData.ASE_EMPGeneratorHediff.description: This experimental reactor produces a decent amount of energy, but its core periodically provokes EMP bursts that can negatively affect other androids and mechanisms.
LanguageData.ASE_EMPGeneratorHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_ExperimentalQuantumReactorHediff.des: An increased-power reactor, but the reformatting time is tripled.
LanguageData.ASE_VanometricReactorHediff.label: vanometric reactor
LanguageData.ASE_VanometricReactorHediff.description: An unstable prototype capable of generating an incredible amount of energy at the cost of an equally incredible amount of waste.
LanguageData.ASE_HandmadeEnergyBoosterHediff.label: handmade reactor
LanguageData.ASE_HandmadeEnergyBoosterHediff.descript: Hand-assembled, extremely rare and fragile experimental reactor model provides incredible power efficiency and work speed, but the android cannot be repaired after damage.
LanguageData.ASE_ExperimentalMechanoidReactorHediff.d: Further increasing the reactor's energy efficiency led to an unexpected effect - its high frequency attracts other mechanoids.
LanguageData.ASE_OverdriveMkIHediff.label: overdrive T1
LanguageData.ASE_OverdriveMkIHediff.description: The android receives a slight optimization in motor circuits. Runs faster, but the battery drains quickly.
LanguageData.ASE_OverdriveMkIHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_OverdriveMkIIHediff.label: overdrive T2
LanguageData.ASE_OverdriveMkIIHediff.description: Overclocking of stepper motor protocols. The android moves even faster, but is unable to carry heavy items.
LanguageData.ASE_OverdriveMkIIHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_OverdriveMkIIIHediff.label: overdrive T3
LanguageData.ASE_OverdriveMkIIIHediff.description: The android moves at the limit of its capabilities, but its carrying capacity in this configuration is minimal.
LanguageData.ASE_OverdriveMkIIIHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocolMkIHediff.label: productivity protocol T1
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocolMkIHediff.descri: Work speed is slightly increased at the cost of higher energy consumption.
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocolMkIIHediff.label: productivity protocol T2
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocolMkIIHediff.descr: Work speed is significantly increased at the cost of even higher energy consumption.
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocolMkIIIHediff.desc: Incredible productivity boost, but the cost is the inability to work at high temperatures.
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolderMkIHediff.label: cargo holder T1
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolderMkIHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolderMkIIHediff.label: cargo holder T2
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolderMkIIHediff.description: Doubled-capacity cargo compartment, but the android's movement speed is slightly reduced.
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolderMkIIHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolderMkIIIHediff.label: cargo holder T3
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolderMkIIIHediff.description: Maximum carrying capacity, but significant speed reduction.
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCoreMkIHediff.label: research core T1
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCoreMkIHediff.description: Improved search and data systematization algorithms increase research speed.
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCoreMkIHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCoreMkIIHediff.label: research core T2
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCoreMkIIHediff.description: Expanded memory blocks for even greater research acceleration.
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCoreMkIIIHediff.label: research core T3
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCoreMkIIIHediff.description: Computational blocks operate at the limit, generating enormous amounts of heat and requiring additional cooling.
LanguageData.ASE_MiningSubroutineMkIHediff.label: mining subroutine T1
LanguageData.ASE_MiningSubroutineMkIHediff.descriptio: Rock structure analysis increases mining efficiency.
LanguageData.ASE_MiningSubroutineMkIIHediff.label: mining subroutine T2
LanguageData.ASE_MiningSubroutineMkIIHediff.descripti: Improved sensors provide even more resources.
LanguageData.ASE_DeepMiningSensorsHediff.label: deep mining sensors
LanguageData.ASE_DeepMiningSensorsHediff.description: Specialized sensors for deep mining of rare resources.
LanguageData.ASE_DrillingSpecialistHediff.label: drilling specialist
LanguageData.ASE_DrillingSpecialistHediff.description: Doubled drilling speed thanks to abandoning standard speech protocols.
LanguageData.ASE_FieldMedicHediff.label: field medic
LanguageData.ASE_FieldMedicHediff.description: Emergency protocols for accelerated treatment of fighters directly on the battlefield. Fast, but not very high quality.
LanguageData.ASE_FieldMedicHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_SurgicalUnitHediff.label: surgical unit
LanguageData.ASE_SurgicalUnitHediff.description: Special model designed for use in elite clinics. Equipment fragility prevents using such an android for heavy work.
LanguageData.ASE_SurgicalUnitHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_AgroDroneHediff.label: agro-drone
LanguageData.ASE_AgroDroneHediff.description: Optimized for harvesting crops and cutting down trees.
LanguageData.ASE_AgroDroneHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_NarcoticHarvesterHediff.label: narcotic harvester
LanguageData.ASE_NarcoticHarvesterHediff.description: Thanks to improved motor skills, ideal for growing illegal crops, but has much lower durability compared to standard models.
LanguageData.ASE_ShredderCoreHediff.label: shredder core
LanguageData.ASE_ShredderCoreHediff.description: Specialized mechanoid processing unit that occasionally finds additional components in them.
LanguageData.ASE_ShredderCoreHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_ButcherCoreHediff.label: butcher core
LanguageData.ASE_ButcherCoreHediff.description: Protocol allows ignoring sanitary standards and butchering carcasses at double speed.
LanguageData.ASE_ButcherCoreHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_SmelterCoreHediff.label: smelter core
LanguageData.ASE_SmelterCoreHediff.description: Special protocol for metal smelting, allows faster smelting and occasionally obtaining rare components.
LanguageData.ASE_SmelterCoreHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_DiplomaticCoreHediff.label: diplomatic core
LanguageData.ASE_DiplomaticCoreHediff.description: Android diplomat for trade and negotiations. As an additional trust factor for the interlocutor, it technically cannot use ranged weapons.
LanguageData.ASE_DiplomaticCoreHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_DecentralizedMindHediff.label: decentralized mind network
LanguageData.ASE_DecentralizedMindHediff.description: Distributed computing allows even load distribution across all android CPUs present on the map, increasing their efficiency.
LanguageData.ASE_ResourceScannerHediff.label: resource scanner
LanguageData.ASE_ResourceScannerHediff.description: Built-in metal detector that sometimes marks previously unknown deposits of valuable materials.
LanguageData.ASE_ResourceScannerHediff.stages.0.label: scanning
LanguageData.ASE_HeavyPlatingMkIHediff.label: heavy plating T1
LanguageData.ASE_HeavyPlatingMkIHediff.description: The android is covered with additional armor plates. Stronger - but noticeably slower.
LanguageData.ASE_HeavyPlatingMkIHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_HeavyPlatingMkIIHediff.label: heavy plating T2
LanguageData.ASE_HeavyPlatingMkIIHediff.description: Thick armor plates turn the android into a walking tank, sacrificing most of its mobility.
LanguageData.ASE_HeavyPlatingMkIIIHediff.label: heavy plating T3
LanguageData.ASE_HeavyPlatingMkIIIHediff.description: Armor has been brought to incredible levels. Almost invulnerable, but barely able to move or work.
LanguageData.ASE_ReactiveArmorHediff.label: reactive armor
LanguageData.ASE_ReactiveArmorHediff.description: Reactive armor that damages attackers in melee combat (returns 100% damage, but also inflicts the same damage on the android itself). Warning: in case of critical damage, the android may explode!
LanguageData.ASE_ReactiveArmorHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_DeflectorSystemHediff.label: deflector system
LanguageData.ASE_DeflectorSystemHediff.description: Experimental reflective panels that reflect bullets back at attackers. Trigger approximately 50% of the time.
LanguageData.ASE_DeflectorSystemHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_MkI.label: anti-insectoid plates
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_MkI.description: Damn insectoids got everyone! Additional layers of experimental composite armor will help better withstand clashes with these creatures.
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_MkII.label: double anti-insectoid plates
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_MkII.description: Damn insectoids got everyone specifically! Additional layers of experimental composite armor will help better withstand clashes with these creatures.
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_MkIII.label: quadro anti-insectoid plates
LanguageData.ASE_AntiInsectoidPlates_MkIII.descriptio: Damn insectoids got everyone so much that engineers took extreme measures! Additional layers of experimental composite armor will help withstand a clash with an entire army of these creatures!
LanguageData.ASE_SilverOverlayHediff.label: silver overlay
LanguageData.ASE_SilverOverlayHediff.description: A special silver coating has been applied to the android's armor. Makes the android noticeably stronger.
LanguageData.ASE_SilverOverlayHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_GoldenOverlayHediff.label: golden overlay
LanguageData.ASE_GoldenOverlayHediff.description: A special gold coating has been applied to the android's armor. Makes the android even stronger, but greatly increases its cost and attracts unwanted attention.
LanguageData.ASE_GoldenOverlayHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_DiamondOverlayHediff.label: diamond overlay
LanguageData.ASE_DiamondOverlayHediff.description: A special diamond particle coating has been applied to the android's armor. It makes the android much stronger, but due to the cost of materials, half the galaxy will hunt for such androids.
LanguageData.ASE_DiamondOverlayHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_WallProtocolHediff.label: wall protocol
LanguageData.ASE_WallProtocolHediff.description: The android is designed specifically for protecting settlements in aggressive worlds. Useless in attack, but in defense will stand forever. Due to huge size and low mobility, unable to travel in caravans.
LanguageData.ASE_WallProtocolHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_ToxicDischargeHediff.label: toxic discharge
LanguageData.ASE_ToxicDischargeHediff.description: When taking damage, the android releases a toxic cloud that damages everyone nearby. The system has 5 charges that restore over time.
LanguageData.ASE_ToxicDischargeHediff.stages.0.label: empty (0/5)
LanguageData.ASE_ToxicDischargeHediff.stages.1.label: low (1/5)
LanguageData.ASE_ToxicDischargeHediff.stages.2.label: half (3/5)
LanguageData.ASE_ToxicDischargeHediff.stages.3.label: full (5/5)
LanguageData.ASE_BerserkerProtocolHediff.label: berserker protocol
LanguageData.ASE_BerserkerProtocolHediff.description: A protocol created for public entertainment: the more damaged the android is, the more ferociously it fights. Very popular in underground arenas.
LanguageData.ASE_BerserkerProtocol_T2_Hediff.label: berserker protocol T2
LanguageData.ASE_BerserkerProtocol_T2_Hediff.descript: Further development of the protocol created for public entertainment: the more damaged the android is, the more ferociously it fights. Due to imperfect technology, it may enter uncontrollable rage and become a threat to everything alive within 1 kilometer (including your colonists).
LanguageData.ASE_SniperOpticsHediff.label: sniper optics
LanguageData.ASE_SniperOpticsHediff.description: Improved optics significantly increase weapon range, but the android itself becomes extremely vulnerable.
LanguageData.ASE_TitanFistHediff.label: titan fist
LanguageData.ASE_TitanFistHediff.description: The android strikes much slower, but puts all its power into each blow.
LanguageData.ASE_UnarmoredEvasionHediff.label: unarmored evasion
LanguageData.ASE_UnarmoredEvasionHediff.description: Thanks to additional servos, the android dodges melee attacks more easily. The fewer items worn by the android, the more effective.
LanguageData.ASE_ScrapWarriorHediff.label: scrap warrior
LanguageData.ASE_ScrapWarriorHediff.description: Thanks to cheap materials, the android is not afraid of damage and deals increased damage. The lower the android's cost, the greater the bonus.
LanguageData.ASE_AutoFeedSystemHediff.label: auto-feed system
LanguageData.ASE_AutoFeedSystemHediff.description: Built-in hand-mounted loading system that allows the android to make up to 5 shots with instant aiming and ×5 firing speed. The system recharges over time.
LanguageData.ASE_AutoFeedSystemHediff.stages.0.label: empty (0/5)
LanguageData.ASE_AutoFeedSystemHediff.stages.1.label: low (1/5)
LanguageData.ASE_AutoFeedSystemHediff.stages.2.label: half (3/5)
LanguageData.ASE_AutoFeedSystemHediff.stages.3.label: full (5/5)
LanguageData.ASE_HeatedCircuitsHediff.label: heated circuits
LanguageData.ASE_HeatedCircuitsHediff.description: The reactor's heat dissipation system is connected to the android's fists, allowing it to cause burns in melee attacks
LanguageData.ASE_PiercingAlgorithmsHediff.label: piercing algorithms
LanguageData.ASE_PiercingAlgorithmsHediff.description: The android can find weak spots in the enemy's armor, but cannot protect its own.
LanguageData.ASE_PerfectAimProtocolHediff.label: perfect aim protocol
LanguageData.ASE_PerfectAimProtocolHediff.description: Improved aiming protocol forces the android to aim for an eternity, but the hit will be perfect.
LanguageData.ASE_SiegeSpecialistHediff.label: siege specialist
LanguageData.ASE_SiegeSpecialistHediff.description: Improved geometric calculation block allows quick and accurate mortar fire, but such androids are often equipped with minimally acceptable armor.
LanguageData.ASE_MeleeOverdrive_MkIHediff.label: melee overdrive T1
LanguageData.ASE_MeleeOverdrive_MkIHediff.description: Android created specifically for foggy and rainy biomes. Cannot use ranged weapons, but fights well in melee.
LanguageData.ASE_MeleeOverdrive_MkIIHediff.label: melee overdrive T2
LanguageData.ASE_MeleeOverdrive_MkIIHediff.descriptio: Android created specifically for foggy and rainy biomes with many hostile creatures. Cannot use ranged weapons, but fights excellently in melee.
LanguageData.ASE_CryoStrikeProtocolHediff.label: cryo-strike protocol
LanguageData.ASE_CryoStrikeProtocolHediff.description: Refrigerant from the cooling system is redirected to the android's fists: each strike cools the target.
LanguageData.ASE_TacticalNetworkHediff.label: tactical network
LanguageData.ASE_TacticalNetworkHediff.description: Real-time tactical data exchange allows androids to fight more effectively.
LanguageData.ASE_TacticalNetworkHediff.stages.0.label: 1 node (+5% combat stats)
LanguageData.ASE_TacticalNetworkHediff.stages.1.label: 2 nodes (+10% combat stats)
LanguageData.ASE_TacticalNetworkHediff.stages.2.label: 3 nodes (+15% combat stats)
LanguageData.ASE_TacticalNetworkHediff.stages.3.label: 4 nodes (+20% combat stats)
LanguageData.ASE_TacticalNetworkHediff.stages.4.label: 5+ nodes (+25% combat stats)
LanguageData.ASE_CombatDataLoggerHediff.label: combat data logger
LanguageData.ASE_CombatDataLoggerHediff.description: With each defeated enemy, the android accumulates vast amounts of data about its target, allowing it to become even more effective.
LanguageData.ASE_BarrageProtocolHediff.label: barrage protocol
LanguageData.ASE_BarrageProtocolHediff.description: The android spends less time aiming, showering the enemy with a hail of bullets, but accuracy leaves much to be desired.
LanguageData.ASE_BarrageProtocolHediff.stages.0.label: active
LanguageData.ASE_ResilienceHediff.label: resilience
LanguageData.ASE_ResilienceHediff.description: Each blow against the android permanently increases its armor by 0.1%.
LanguageData.ASE_AutoRepairModuleHediff.label: auto-repair module
LanguageData.ASE_AutoRepairModuleHediff.description:
Nano-machines restore any damage, but consume a fabulous amount of energy.
Effect: Automatic damage restoration. Lost limbs require more time to restore.
